qualifications.finding: Date validity is enforced by resolveCodexSessionBackfillDateRoots, but that function filters/maps without sorting or deduplicating. mergeCodexSessionBackfillDates sorts/deduplicates on the existing-baseline path; a no-baseline requested scanDates array can retain duplicates/order. The candidate's broad date-dedup wording is qualified accordingly.
qualifications.tests: AR-T03/04 must characterize duplicate and reordered requested roots with and without a baseline; no correction implemented.

qualifications.finding: Raw trust regex can classify text inside multiline strings. Untrusted project blocks survive extractOrdinaryCodexSettings despite its comment; project Unicode decoding differs from scalar parser. Accepted as source characterization, not intended trust policy.
qualifications.tests: AR-T01 preserves baseline and separately names parser/trust correction assertions.

qualifications.finding: Launch return is not history completion. Unsupported hardlinks can coexist with a marker. MCP/auth/history changes can precede later errors or marker failure; pointer fallback can remove the old link before a second rename fails. No cross-operation rollback, durable flush, provider resume or multi-process CAS is proved.

Actual product reads only a cached static hint, not evaluated shell state. All-three-bash-file scan, ignored empty/unset/conditional semantics and process-lifetime caching need actual-shell differential tests. The original fish unsupported-shell title only demonstrates no zsh/bash fallback.

The report's inherited testPreservation prose says thirteen body groups; the new report has ten and inherits thirteen from account-launch-final. Both associations remain. AL-SR01 is outside this report and is reconciled by the separately accepted provider source review, not silently closed here. The pending 95-provider owning-body corrections are outside these native/WSL bridge bodies and remain open.
